notes:
The Malaria Atlas Project Data Platform provides different tools to learn about, explore, and work with malaria data.

The platform also provides malaria data at varying levels of detail to suit different needs.

This suite of tools aims to support the needs of diverse audiences, including the general public, the media, policy analysts, engineers, as well as researchers.

organization.title: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)
organization.description: ICPAC is a Climate Center accredited by the World Meteorological Organization that provides Climate Services to 11 East African Countries. Our services aim at creating resilience in a region deeply affected by climate change and extreme weather.
